From the manufacturer

Keurig K-Elite Single Serve K-Cup Pod Coffee Maker

Product Details

The Keurig K-Elite brewer blends a premium finish and programmable features to deliver both modern design and the ultimate in beverage customization. With a striking brushed finish and metal details, it’s a stylish addition to any kitchen. The Keurig K-Elite coffee maker features Strong Brew for when you want to brew a bolder cup of coffee, and an Iced button to brew hot over ice for a refreshing, full-flavored iced coffee. It features five brew sizes, so you can brew 4, 6, 8, 10, or 12oz of your favorite coffee, tea, hot cocoa, or iced beverage at the touch of a button. Choose from hundreds of delicious varieties of K-Cup pods, or brew your own ground coffee using the Universal My K-Cup Reusable Coffee Filter (sold separately).

In addition to a host of programmable features like auto on and temperature control, the Keurig K-Elite coffee maker provides hot water on demand for instant soups and oatmeal, and the large 75oz removable water reservoir lets you brew 8 cups between refills.

Key Features:

  • Alerts you when it is time to descale your coffee maker. Descaling is an important process that removes built-up calcium deposits, ensuring the best-tasting brew possible.
  • Just insert a pod, select your desired cup size, and brew your perfect cup in under a minute.
  • Compatible with the My K-Cup Universal Reusable Coffee Filter, allowing you to brew with your own ground coffee.

More Features

  • Perfect for instant soups or oatmeal
  • Increases the strength and bold taste of your coffee’s flavor
  • Brew hot over ice at the touch of a button for full-flavored delicious iced coffee
  • Brews K-Cup pods in under a minute
  • Minimizes noise when the coffee maker is in use

Product Description

The Keurig K-Elite® single serve coffee maker blends premium finish and programmable features together to deliver both modern design and the ultimate in beverage customization. With a striking brushed finish and metal details, it’s a stylish addition to any kitchen. The Keurig K-Elite® coffee maker features a Strong Brew setting when you want to brew a bolder cup of coffee, and an Iced setting to brew hot over ice for a refreshing, full-flavored iced coffee. It features five brew sizes, so you can brew 4, 6, 8, 10, or 12oz of your favorite coffee, tea, hot cocoa, or iced beverage in minutes at the touch of a button. Choose from hundreds of delicious varieties of K-Cup® pods, or brew your own ground coffee using the Universal My K-Cup® Reusable Coffee Filter (sold separately). In addition to a host of programmable features like temperature control, the Keurig K-Elite® coffee maker provides hot water on demand for instant soups and oatmeal, and the large 75oz removable water filter let you brew multiple cups between refills.*Cup not included*

BEST TIME OF DAY!!
I LOVE KEURIG!! we recently went to our friends where she made us a cappuccino with her new cappuccino maker. After three days, My husband and I both talked about how we couldn't wait to go home and have a cup of coffee the "real way". Yes, there is something to be said for having a special coffee, but for us, our Keurig cant be beat for taste and consistency. Nothing beats that taste of a nice cup of coffee in the morning just the way you like. We had our last Keurig for 12 years! We took care of it by cleaning it and replacing filters every three months. The only reason we got a new one was because it was not filling the cup all the way. My husband took our old keurig and put it in the trailer...perfect. if you're thinking about buying a keurig, don't think twice .. It simply is a great cup of coffee.Every single day! So many pods to choose from. Never boring.

    I’ve been really happy with the Keurig K-Elite. It’s one of those appliances that does exactly what I need it to do without making my morning more complicated.

    It heats up quickly, is easy to use, and I really like having several cup-size options depending on how much coffee I want. The Strong Brew setting is probably my favorite feature because I prefer a bolder cup, and it actually makes a noticeable difference. The large water reservoir is another big plus since I’m not constantly having to refill it.

    I also appreciate that it gives you more control than a basic single-serve machine while still keeping everything convenient. The controls are straightforward, cleanup is easy, and it consistently makes a good cup of coffee.

    If you like the convenience of K-Cups but want a machine with a few more useful features than the basic models, the K-Elite is a solid choice. I use mine regularly and would definitely buy it again.

    I purchased this Keurig K-Elite for my daughter, but I have been using it too, so I’ve had a chance to try the main features myself. We purchased it recently, and it has already been a great buy. I have used Keurig machines for years, and this one has a couple of features that really make it stand out.

    What I like:

    • The iced coffee feature works really well

    • It makes better iced coffee than just brewing a regular K-cup over ice

    • The iced setting seems to get the strength and ratio right so it does not taste watered down

    • Works with regular K-cups for iced coffee

    • Hot water on demand is very useful

    • Great for tea, oatmeal, hot cocoa mixes, and other hot drinks

    • Easy to set up

    • Directions were easy to understand

    • Brews regular K-cups nicely too

    • I like the variety of cup sizes

    • The water reservoir size is convenient without making the machine too bulky

    • Feels quieter than other Keurigs I have used

    • Fits nicely on the countertop

    Things to be aware of:

    • It is quieter than some other Keurigs, but it is not completely silent

    • It still makes some normal brewing and heating sounds

    • If placing it under cabinets, remember the handle needs extra clearance when opened

    • I do recommend keeping up with descaling because I think it helps with both taste and machine longevity

    • We use our Keurigs heavily, and while none have lasted forever for us, we keep coming back to the brand

    Overall:

    This is a great Keurig, and the iced coffee and hot water features are what make it feel special. It is easy to use, brews well, and has features I would really miss now.

    Nice Coffee Maker as Expected from Keurig
    Reviewed in the United States on July 19, 2026
    Color: Brushed Slate
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.

    I received my Keurig K-Elite Single Serve K-Cup Pod Coffee Maker yesterday so I don't have a lot of use to review it by but I will say that having had several Keurig coffee makers in the past I like the look, feel and utility of this model. I read several reviews prior to purchase that claimed the temperature of the brew was not as hot as was set in the machine. I experienced the same and wanted to understand it better. I have my machine set at 190 for the temperature. I used a calibrated Thermapen ONE Thermometer, the one chefs use and rely on, and the temp of the coffee in my cup right after brewing completed was 158. Then I measured the brew as it exits the machine but before it got into my cup and it was 187. Turns out my ceramic cup was at room temperature and some of the heat from the brew was used up to heat my cup, which lowered the resultant temp of the coffee in my cup. Bottom line: my machine is very close to the temp I set for the brew. If I preheat my cup the coffee in my cup will be very close to what I have my machine set to. So I am happy and my coffee maker is performing as specified.

About this Item

  • WHAT'S IN THE BOX: One water filter handle, and one filter to help ensure your beverages taste their absolute best.
  • BREWS MULTIPLE CUP SIZES: 4, 6, 8, 10, 12oz Enjoy the most popular cup sizes.
  • STRONG BREW: Brew a stronger, more intense cup.
  • ICED SETTING: Brew hot over ice at the touch of a button for full-flavored, delicious iced coffee.
  • HOT WATER ON DEMAND BUTTON: Perfect for instant soups or oatmeal.
  • FAST & FRESH BREWED: Coffee made in minutes.
  • LARGE 75oz WATER RESERVOIR: Allows you to brew multiple cups before having to refill, saving you time and simplifying your morning routine. Removable reservoir makes refilling easy.
  • BREWER MAINTENANCE REMINDER: Alerts you when it is time to descale your coffee maker. Descaling is an important process that removes built-up calcium deposits, ensuring the best-tasting brew possible.
  • REMOVABLE DRIP TRAY: Accommodates travel mugs up to 7.2” tall and holds a full accidental brew for easy cleanup.
  • QUIET BREW TECHNOLOGY: Minimizes noise when the coffee maker is in use.

Product Description

The Keurig K-Elite® single serve coffee maker blends premium finish and programmable features together to deliver both modern design and the ultimate in beverage customization. With a striking brushed finish and metal details, it’s a stylish addition to any kitchen. The Keurig K-Elite® coffee maker features a Strong Brew setting when you want to brew a bolder cup of coffee, and an Iced setting to brew hot over ice for a refreshing, full-flavored iced coffee. It features five brew sizes, so you can brew 4, 6, 8, 10, or 12oz of your favorite coffee, tea, hot cocoa, or iced beverage in minutes at the touch of a button. Choose from hundreds of delicious varieties of K-Cup® pods, or brew your own ground coffee using the Universal My K-Cup® Reusable Coffee Filter (sold separately). In addition to a host of programmable features like temperature control, the Keurig K-Elite® coffee maker provides hot water on demand for instant soups and oatmeal, and the large 75oz removable water filter let you brew multiple cups between refills.*Cup not included*
